;Health and environment
*The [[Sunspot Solar Observatory]] in [[New Mexico]] is set to reopen on Monday after being closed due to "an on-going law enforcement investigation of criminal activity that occurred at Sacramento Peak" in which "a suspect in the investigation potentially posed a threat to the safety of local staff and residents". [https://www.cnet.com/news/aliens-sadly-not-to-blame-for-closure-of-new-mexico-solar-observatory/ (CNET)]
*A man and a woman are taken ill after a medical incident in [[Salisbury]], [[United Kingdom]]. Police seal off a restaurant as a precautionary measure. According to ''[[The Guardian]]'', tensions are high due to recent [[Novichok]] [[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal|poisonings]]. According to the [[BBC]], "there's no suggestion that this is connected". According to Sky News, at least one of the individuals who fell ill is a Russian. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/sep/16/emergency-services-attend-medical-incident-in-salisbury-restaurant (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45541249 (BBC)] [https://news.sky.com/story/salisbury-restaurant-cordoned-off-by-police-after-pair-taken-ill-11500197 (Sky News)]
*Two people die and 700 others seek medical attention, including three people in critical condition at the [[Defqon.1 Festival]] in [[Sydney]], [[Australia]], for drug-related issues. [[Premier of New South Wales]] [[Gladys Berejiklian]] says that the event is dangerous and will never take place again, effectively banning the music festival. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-45539671 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*Forty-one inmates escape from [[Hpa-an Township]]'s main prison in [[Kayin State]], [[Myanmar]], after hijacking a garbage truck and driving it through the prison gates. Eleven of the escapees are apprehended by [[Myanmar Police Force|police]], but 30 remain at large. [https://www.mmtimes.com/news/police-pursue-30-inmates-after-daring-hpa-prison-break.html (''The Myanmar Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Syria]]
**[[Elections in Syria|Local elections]] are held in government-held areas of [[Syria]] for the first time since 2011. [http://tass.com/world/1021781 (TASS)]
*[[Jimmy Morales|Government of Jimmy Morales]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Guatemala]] annuls the decision of [[Jimmy Morales|President Jimmy Morales]] to prevent the entrance to [[Guatemala]] to the head of the [[International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala]] [[Iván Velásquez Gómez]]. In the resolution, President Morales is forced to exhaust the dialogue with the [[United Nations]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/guatemalas-constitutional-court-orders-president-jimmy-morales-head-57870300 (ABC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[British space programme]]
**The first of a series of [[United Kingdom|British]] satellites, known as NovaSAR, is launched from [[Satish Dhawan Space Centre]] in [[India]]. The [[Surrey Satellite Technology]] satellite is designed to monitor suspicious shipping activity. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-45523677 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Berlin Marathon]]
**[[Eliud Kipchoge]] of [[Kenya]] sets a new world record for the fastest [[marathon]] time, at 2:01:39. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/45539546 (BBC)]
*[[Décastar]]
**At the season's last [[IAAF Combined Events Challenge]] in [[Talence]], [[France|French]] athlete [[Kevin Mayer]] breaks the [[decathlon]] world record with a score of 9,126 points. [https://www.iaaf.org/news/report/decastar-talence-2018-mayer-world-record (IAAF)]
